title: Why your brain hates Mondays
hooks: Your brain literally punishes you for sleeping in on weekends.
Mondays feel awful for one weird biological reason.
body: It's called social jet lag. When you sleep two hours later on Saturday and Sunday, your internal clock drifts, just like flying two time zones west. Then Monday morning, you drag it back. Your body reacts the same way it does after a real flight. Foggy head, low mood, cravings for junk food. The fix isn't more sleep. It's a consistent wake up time, even on weekends, within about an hour. Do that for two weeks and Monday stops feeling like a wall.
cta: Follow for one brain hack every single day.
caption: Mondays aren't the problem. Your weekend sleep schedule is. Here's the two-week fix.
youtube_description: Social jet lag explains the Monday slump. One habit fixes it in two weeks.
